notes: Trusted screenshot over raw. Raw's dominant sans-serif/12px/400 row (count 1294) is the SVG-text/measurement noise floor, dropped. Real families are three: Larken serif (editorial headlines), TWK Lausanne grotesque (the giant wordmark + UI), Geist Mono (uppercase tracked labels). bg normalized to warm bone #f6f7f3 and fg to warm near-black #1c1a16 (NOT pure #000); dark sections invert to the same #1c1a16. Accent is the literal browser-default link blue #0000ee (count 45) with a brighter #0e8ef0 variant on the email pill — kept as-is because the unstyled-blue is an intentional anti-design move. Display scale tops out ~90px (wordmark renders far larger via edge bleed/clipping, not font-size). Radius set is large-and-soft: 13/25/30px panels + pill (200px≈full). No shadows anywhere — flat. Spacing base read as a 5px grid.
